claim: The WP9b API tests pass over integration @ 0475dea. Reject, flag, deprecate, confirm, approve and budget write correct HumanActions, and a missing or blank required reason is 400. Cancel, retry, create-task, priority, pause and resume go through WP6's Operations, which writes the HumanAction as the operator. Flagging a Solution starts a re-verification solve loop; flagging a Template is a flag only. /inbox is WP6's generator, including improvement_pending items with approve/reject. Approve-profile moves current_profile; a real batch verifies ok and fails after an edit. The /agent/* token endpoints (show, why, query, validate-template, validate-family, submit) work only with a valid token for a live task, record cli spans with the task, and submit moves the task to submitted with a Submission. Experiment progress and quotas are covered, as are the task, agents, pool, experiments and improvement views, the WP9b gate tests and WP9a's view tests. Stores are seeded by tools/kta_devseed (origin fixture); code stage only (D320).
command: uv run --frozen pytest -v tests/unit/test_api_actions.py tests/unit/test_api_wp9b_views.py tests/unit/test_api_wiring.py tests/unit/test_api_agent.py tests/unit/test_gate_wp9b.py tests/unit/test_api_views.py

claim: The web frontend type-checks and builds from git archive HEAD web in a fresh directory, with the lockfile-installed node_modules linked in. It includes the round-3 additions: coverage direct test and pending map, improvement approve/reject, experiment progress, quotas, priority.
command: T=$(mktemp -d) && git archive --format=tar HEAD web | tar -x -C $T && ln -s $PWD/web/node_modules $T/web/node_modules && cd $T/web && npm run build

claim: A real uvicorn server runs create_app(open_api(ctx)) over a fresh fixture store (181 fixture records, plus one real AgentProfile written by the smoke script). Every read endpoint and /quotas answer 200. Reject without a reason is 400; with one it writes a HumanAction and marks dependents stale. Flag on a Solution starts a re-verification. Budget, cancel (running -> cancelled), retry (escalated -> queued), create-task (human:<id> work unit), priority, pause and resume answer 200 through WP6's Operations. Approve-profile moves current_profile, and a batch built from the profile verifies ok. /agent/records and /write/record are 403 without a token, and also 403 with a token when no key exists. Fixture subjects only: the real-record acceptance is pending (D320).
command: KTA_DATA=~/kta-data scripts/seed-dev --wp WP9b-fixture-dbec6a3 && KTA_ENV=dev KTA_WP=WP9b-fixture-dbec6a3 KTA_DATA=~/kta-data uv run --frozen python api_smoke.py 7331
